entities.name: Saccharomyces cerevisiae SSU1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P41930; length 458 aa.
Annotated as a multi-pass cell-membrane sulfite efflux pump.
GO annotations include sulfite transmembrane transporter activity and sulfite transmembrane transport.
Also annotated to plasma membrane, cell periphery, and endoplasmic reticulum.
Predicted Pfam SLAC1 domain spans residues 12-409.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 52,544.6 Da and theoretical pI is 8.73.

entities.name: Candida albicans SSU1
observations: Reviewed homolog with 31.6% identity over 86.5% query coverage; annotated as a sulfite efflux pump and multi-pass plasma-membrane protein.
The homolog supports conservation of SSU1 sulfite-export function across budding yeast.

entities.name: Schizosaccharomyces pombe SPBPB10D8.04c
observations: Reviewed homolog with 31.1% identity over 84.1% query coverage; annotated as a multi-pass plasma-membrane sulfite transporter/exporter.

entities.name: Sulfite transmembrane transport
observations: SSU1 is annotated to sulfite transmembrane transport and sulfite export across the plasma membrane.

entities.name: SSU1 sequence properties
observations: 458 aa; calculated molecular weight 52,544.6 Da; theoretical pI 8.73; positive charge estimate at pH 7 is 7.11; GRAVY 0.5264.
The strongly hydrophobic sequence and SLAC1 domain are consistent with an integral multi-pass membrane protein.
